qa.overall_assessment: Mixed result: 7 of 8 ACs pass cleanly, but AC6 has a critical NEW regression. Sidebar (AC1/AC3) is now perfect 6 pure-city groups. Days 9-11 Xi'an content (AC2) is gone. Day 4/6/8/13 timeline (AC4) shows all booked items at correct times. Meal alternatives collapsed (AC5). No console errors (AC8). BUT: AC6 — the Matilde phantom card is correctly suppressed AND the dev report claimed Jade's accommodation_jade card (五道口自如寓 / 珍宝酒店) renders for Days 9/10/11/12/13/14 — IT DOES NOT. Days 10, 11, 12 (May 11/12/13) and Days 13-14 (May 14-15) show ZERO accommodation card. Jade's home is invisible. PLAN_DATA contains the data correctly, but the renderer's accommodation_jade rendering only fires when accommodation (primary) is also non-null. The BUG-G fix that nulled primary accommodation also unintentionally suppressed the secondary jade card. User will see this regression immediately on the same Day 10/11 cards they previously screenshotted complaining of phantom emptiness — now they're truly empty for accommodation.

Day 5 (May 6) timeline: ONE Lunch (院8里少城记忆老川菜), ONE Dinner (饕林餐厅), ONE Breakfast (白家肥肠粉). Skip/跳过 substring not found anywhere. Verified via regex scan of body.innerText.

AC6.evidence: PARTIAL PASS / NEW REGRESSION. (a) Matilde 自行 phantom suppressed: '马蒂尔德'+'自行安排' substring NOT found on any of Days 9-15 — PASS. (b) Day 4-8 喜樂院子 cards present — PASS. (c) Day 3 屿悦民宿 card present (★★★★) — PASS. BUT (d) Days 9-15 accommodation_jade rendering is BROKEN: PLAN_DATA contains accommodation_jade for Days 8 (五道口自如寓), 9-11 (五道口自如寓), 12 (上海人民广场南京东路步行街珍宝酒店), 13-14 (五道口自如寓), 15 (出发日). On Day 8 the renderer DOES show '🏨 JADE 住 自如寓·五道口店' as a separate card. On Days 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 the renderer shows ZERO accommodation cards (accCount=0, jadeAccount=0, ziroomShown=false). User cannot see where Jade is sleeping for 6 nights. Day 12 (May 13 – Shanghai) shows no 珍宝酒店 card. This is a NEW regression introduced by the BUG-G fix: the renderer's accommodation_jade rendering must require accommodation (primary) to also be non-null. The dev report falsely claimed 'accommodation_jade still populated (自如寓·五道口店 for Days 9/10/11/13/14, 珍宝酒店 for Day 12)' — the DATA is populated but the RENDERER drops it. Screenshot: qa-20260505-060527-day11-may12-no-accommodation.png shows Day 11 (May 12) jumping from Meals straight to Budget with no accommodation section.

AC7.evidence: Image broken-src audit on all 15 days: ZERO empty/broken src across all days (totalImgs=11..18 per day, broken=0). However, Days 10-12 (May 11/12/13) have only 3 images each because they're missing accommodation cards (AC6 regression). The user's perception of 'many photos missing' may be partially restored to 'many sections missing' on those days. Acceptable on photo terms but visual emptiness persists for a different reason.

AC8.evidence: Console errors = 0 across full session navigation through all 15 days + Kanban/Timeline view toggles. Only 4 warnings: 2x 'Mixed Content' for image URL upgrade, 2x 'in-browser Babel' transform notice. Both are non-blocking infrastructure warnings.

regressions_found.fix_recommendation: In scripts/generate-html-interactive.py, decouple accommodation_jade rendering from primary accommodation guard. Render accommodation_jade as long as it is non-empty, regardless of whether primary accommodation is null. Inspect renderer line 992-1027.
